subject: Sunbeam: Order Form redlines — output ownership evidence & feedback license
messages:
From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@sunbeam.health
Date: Tue, 1 Oct 2029 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to flag a couple of items in the order form (attached redline) before we move to signatures: specifically, Sunbeam needs an explicit carveout that customer-generated output is owned by Sunbeam when it contains proprietary patient templates, and an explicit training/feedback opt-out for the first 24 months of production.

Two asks to help move this along:
- Can Redwood accept an explicit (non-exclusive) assignment of output for productized features that were trained on our templates?
- What evidence can Redwood provide to demonstrate that we control dataset access (SOC2 artifact or access logs) so our security team signs off?

I attached the redline from our counsel. Procurement prefers to close this week.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

Emma
Procurement, Sunbeam Health

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.example>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, laura_bennett@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 1 Oct 2029 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear redline. We can absolutely work through this. Quick summary of what I can commit to now and what I need to confirm with Legal/OPS: 

Commitments I can tentatively offer:
- A customer output carveout limited to outputs that contain customer-supplied proprietary templates or data (we'll propose specific language).
- A 24-month feedback opt-out window during which customer content will not be used to improve general-purpose models.

Info I need to confirm and evidence we can provide:
- SOC2 artifact access and an operations note about access controls (I looped in Laura for this).
- The specific mechanism for an "assignment" vs "license" for outputs — Ben, can you weigh in on whether we can accept an assignment or should remain a license with an explicit exclusivity carveout?

I attached a short proposed feedback-license note for your counsel's review. If that looks reasonable we can push a DocuSign-ready order form by Thursday.

Best,
Aisha
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example, Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 1 Oct 2029 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Emma / Aisha — quick legal read: we should avoid a broad assignment of "ownership" of model parameters. Two practical approaches that are defensible for both sides:

1) Output assignment carveout (recommended):
- Redwood grants customer ownership of "Customer-Generated Output" defined narrowly as outputs that contain Customer Content (templates, datasets) provided to Redwood and identified in Exhibit A.
- Redwood retains model IP and metrics; customer gets perpetual, worldwide ownership of the specific output artifacts.

2) Exclusive license plus evidence:
- If Sunbeam needs paper that reads like an assignment, we can grant a perpetual, exclusive, transferable license to the Customer-Generated Output with the same practical rights as ownership (incl. sublicensing) and include a warranty of non-use for general model training for 24 months.

Ben notes / next steps:
- We need Exhibit A to list templates or data types to avoid ambiguity.
- Laura: ops can supply SOC2 scope doc and a sample access log extract (redacted).
- We should include a short audit right clause for the 24-month window.

Happy to draft precise language. Ben
Counsel (Contracts), Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example, Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
Date: Wed, 2 Oct 2029 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Emma — attached is the SOC2 scoping summary and a sanitized sample access log extract showing role-based access to customer data buckets. Quick notes:
- We can produce the SOC2 Type II report under NDA; procurement frequently accepts the scoping summary and a redacted sample instead of full artifacts during negotiation.
- For the 24-month non-use/feedback opt-out we can enable a tenant-level flag that prevents content from being surfaced to training pipelines; we will include an operational attestation and a monitoring hook (daily job output) for the initial 24 months.

Attachments: Sunbeam_SOC2_evidence.pdf (scoping summary + sample logs)

Laura
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@sunbeam.health, ben_carter@redwood.example, laura_bennett@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 2 Oct 2029 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Thanks Laura & Ben — that helps. A few clarifying items from our legal team after reviewing your proposals:
- Exhibit A: we'll provide a list of 3 representative templates and a note that additional templates can be added by mutual amendment. Good to keep that limited.
- Audit right: can the audit be scoped to a review of logs and attestation only (no on-site or access to raw patient records)?
- The procurement team wants the feedback opt-out to be explicit in the order form (not buried in SOW/Exhibit).

If Redwood can produce a DocuSign-ready order form with Ben's preferred language (option 1 or 2) and Laura's attestation text in an attachment, procurement will route for signature today. We can take the audit scoping language in a separate short addendum if needed.

Emma

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.example>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@sunbeam.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, laura_bennett@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 3 Oct 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — output ownership carveout request

Emma — thanks, all. Final plan and immediate next steps: 

1) Ben will draft the order form clause as "Output Assignment Carveout (narrow)" and include an Exhibit A placeholder.
2) Laura will attach the operational attestation and the scoping summary (the two files attached in this thread).
3) We will include a 24-month feedback non-use clause explicitly in the signature block of the order form and a one-paragraph audit-rights addendum limited to logs and attestations only.

I'll circulate a DocuSign-ready packet (Order Form + Exhibit A template + Ops Attestation) within 4 hours. Emma — if procurement confirms they will accept the redacted SOC2 scoping summary + attestation in lieu of the full report, we'll mark this ready for signature and route to DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/sunbeam/orderform/abc123

Thanks — moving to action now.

Best,
Aisha
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Sunbeam_OrderForm_redline.docx, proposed-feedback-license.txt
